selection_rule: Acquire every Phytoplankton data package in the checksum-pinned SHARK catalogue because dataset names do not provide reliable record-level frozen-domain geography.
license_evidence: Official SHARK API documentation states all published data are CC0; corroborated by archived MarineInfo records for national and regional SMHI phytoplankton packages.
citation: Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI), Swedish Ocean Archive (SHARK), versioned phytoplankton data packages.
